items.q: INTERVIEWER mentions 'Jimmy Smith' in a list of names/records; INTERVIEWEE does not mention Jimmy Smith or describe any interaction.

ctx.x: And I could show you a copy except for the fact that I gave it to Jimmy Owens for his birthday and one of King Oliver too. And I knew that I could get more from Harrison Smith. So I thought this
might be a little interesting thing for Jimmy Smith, I mean, Smith, listen to that. (LAUGHTER). Jimmy Owens. And out of the ordinary.
